hiddenTriangles: hidden_triangles: triangles whose centre lies strictly inside (by more than 0.1 mm) another convex solid of the same object (the solids welded by position): closed, every edge shared by exactly two of its triangles, or open along one plane only (a box with no bottom, or no back against a wall), that plane then one of its faces; an open strip (a leaf) hides nothing. Or pressed face to face on another triangle (the same centre, opposite normals). n/a for lines, points and geometry whose arrays could not be read.
gaps: Clouds: no mesh; drawn by ray marching in the post chain (src/render/postprocess.ts CLOUD_SHADOWS).
Vehicles' intermediate levels: made at run time by the simplifier (vehicleLevels.ts partLevels, meshoptimizer); the catalogue gives the full model (L0) and the far model.
Pictures: the colours are each material's base colour where its look needs the running game (baked surfaces, the engine's uniforms); the geometry and every number are the engine's.
Editor feedback on the ground (src/render/renderer.ts blink) and the tools' 2D gizmos (drawn on a canvas over the view): no catalogued mesh.
Run without the game (--no-game): no copies, costs (triangles x copies), draw calls or destruction peak: those are counted in a generated city.
